label: Homey Pro (Early 2023) smart home hub
description: Athom Homey Pro (Early 2023) is a local-first hub with eight radios (Wi-Fi 2.4/5 GHz, Zigbee, Z-Wave Plus, BLE, 433 MHz RF, infrared, Matter and Thread) and NO Ethernet port: wired networking needs the separately sold Homey Pro Ethernet adapter, so its only IP interface is Wi-Fi.
